What if the next four months decide how prepared you are for Mains when Prelims is over?

September to December is the phase when serious UPSC aspirants should build their Mains foundation instead of waiting for January. Santosh Sir explains how to use these four months to complete your notes, PYQs, current affairs, answer writing and revision while balancing GS and Optional.
